title: When Can I Fly After a BBL? Nights to Stay Before Flying
meta_description: Plan on 7 to 10 days in Miami after a BBL, cleared by your surgeon before you fly. How to sit, move and stay safe on the flight home.
excerpt: If you are flying in for a BBL, plan on 7 to 10 days in Miami, seen at follow-up and cleared before you fly. How many nights to stay, how to sit on the plane, how to lower your risk of a blood clot, when to delay your flight, and who arranges what.
quick_answer:
When can I fly after a BBL?

Plan on 7 to 10 days in Miami, so you can be seen at follow-up and cleared first. An ASPS article advises staying near your surgeon at least 4 to 5 days, or as long as possible, and a surgeon quoted there says infection typically shows up in 3 to 5 days.

images.text_in_image:
Before you fly after a BBL

Plan on 7 to 10 days in Miami, until follow-up and clearance
Walk for 5 to 10 minutes for every hour you sit
Remain well hydrated
Ask about compression stockings
Take your pillow on any flight

Breathing trouble, chest pain or an unusual heartbeat: seek medical attention immediately

Sources: ASPS, Cleveland Clinic, CDC
